--- pipe_set.sql
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT * FROM Singers
  |> SET FirstName = UPPER(FirstName), `Last Name` = "unknown",
)

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Select{
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.Star{
        Star: 7,
      },
    },
    From: &ast.From{
      From:   9,
      Source: &ast.SubQueryTableExpr{
        Lparen: 14,
        Rparen: 104,
        Query:  &ast.Query{
          Query: &ast.Select{
            Select:  18,
            Results: []ast.SelectItem{
              &ast.Star{
                Star: 25,
              },
            },
            From: &ast.From{
              From:   27,
              Source: &ast.TableName{
                Table: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 32,
                  NameEnd: 39,
                  Name:    "Singers",
                },
              },
            },
          },
          PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
            &ast.PipeSet{
              Pipe:  42,
              Items: []*ast.PipeSetItem{
                &ast.PipeSetItem{
                  Column: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 49,
                    NameEnd: 58,
                    Name:    "FirstName",
                  },
                  Equal: 59,
                  Expr:  &ast.CallExpr{
                    Rparen: 76,
                    Func:   &ast.Path{
                      Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                        &ast.Ident{
                          NamePos: 61,
                          NameEnd: 66,
                          Name:    "UPPER",
                        },
                      },
                    },
                    Args: []ast.Arg{
                      &ast.ExprArg{
                        Expr: &ast.Ident{
                          NamePos: 67,
                          NameEnd: 76,
                          Name:    "FirstName",
                        },
                      },
                    },
                  },
                },
                &ast.PipeSetItem{
                  Column: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 79,
                    NameEnd: 90,
                    Name:    "Last Name",
                  },
                  Equal: 91,
                  Expr:  &ast.StringLiteral{
                    ValuePos: 93,
                    ValueEnd: 102,
                    Value:    "unknown",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM Singers |> SET FirstName = UPPER(FirstName), `Last Name` = "unknown")
